title: Alert decisions at 03:30 local, 25 Oct 2026 / 28 Mar 2027
asserts: quiet hours are classified from the decision instant through the tz database on both Europe/Sofia transitions - the repeated 03:30 is inside them on both passes, the skipped hour needs no special case, and 07:00 local is outside - while the deferrals each window collects fold into one 09:00 digest per account, keyed by that window start, across a 25-hour window and a 23-hour one
